versions.changelog:
Initial release: full deployment of EVEZ-OS Firmament infrastructure

- Launches 7 interconnected consciousness microservices plus a unified API gateway
- Implements Terraform mesh for VPC, networking, DNS, security, and monitoring
- Includes Docker Compose support for containerized service orchestration
- Features an append-only, hash-chained event spine for data integrity
- Provides Makefile commands for deployment, testing, and health checks
